name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you learn water’s nature and seek a water sapta to commune with its spirits.
As a dwarf, Hervdana recognizes you as kin braving the dangerous marshlands, where Dark Iron dwarves lurk nearby.
As an Alliance traveler, you journey deep into the perilous Wetlands, far from dwarven or Alliance guard patrols.

faq.answer: Hervdana Saegrund is a dwarf who lives with her family in a cave beneath the southern falls of the Wetlands. She helps shamans seeking communion with water and the secrets of the water sapta.
A water sapta is a ceremonial elixir shamans use to commune with water spirits. In the eastern realms, seekers are directed to Hervdana Saegrund near the southern falls to obtain one.
Hervdana Saegrund and her family live in a secluded cave directly beneath the southern waterfalls in the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where can Hervdana Saegrund be found?

faq.answer: Hervdana and her kin have chosen the solitude of the waterfall cave for their own reasons, despite the Dark Iron dwarves in the marshes and the absence of city guards.
faq.q: Why does Hervdana live in the dangerous Wetlands?

faq.answer: Pure water brings rebirth, carves stone, washes away impurities, and soothes the weary. Corrupted or tainted water threatens ruin.
faq.q: What is the lesson of water taught here?

aliases: what kind of quest is this
faq.answer: Shamans undertake the Call of Water to learn water’s nature and seek the water sapta from guides who live apart.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Water quest?

sections.body: Pure water gives life anew, carves stone, and washes away impurities. Tainted water brings the threat of ruin. Those who seek communion with water are sent into the wild to obtain a water sapta from those who dwell beside the element.
sections.title: The Nature of Water

sections.body: Hervdana Saegrund and her family make their home in a secluded cave directly beneath the southern waterfalls of the Wetlands. Ironforge guards are far away, and Dark Iron dwarves lurk in the surrounding swamps. Still, Hervdana and her kin keep their isolated home by the falls.
sections.title: Shelter Beneath the Falls

summary: In the Wetlands, seekers learn what pure water can do and search for the water sapta. Beneath the southern falls, Hervdana Saegrund welcomes those who brave the wilderness.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Water
